scope: One backend experiment: replace recognized scalar metadata relation fan-out with a parameterized same-snapshot JOIN. Exact scope recognition; unfamiliar predicates use the existing Prisma path. Existing canonical privacy/filter/order/facet functions remain authoritative.
constraints: No auth cache, GET/owner/freshness changes, production infrastructure/schema/index/dependency or publication changes.

measurement.powerControl: Temporary caffeinate; exclude entire interrupted collection.

additionalValidation: Same constrained network/CPU and bounded 1/2/4 HTTP reads as Phase 8; all planned rows retained. Full existing QA plus raw-query scope/native parity regressions.
publication: Local commit only; report regressions and hold if not a clear replacement.
hypothesis: Avoid four scalar metadata relation statements and large per-user IN lists with one parameterized join. Ranking remains O(N), related page hydration stays bounded at 100; later interactions still require fresh live GETs.
